patients_observed.description: What a clinician sees at the bedside: demographics, renal estimates, organ support, pathogen and measured MIC. No hidden truth.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Unique patient key shared by all tables.

columns.name: crcl_cg_est_ml_min_173
columns.description: Creatinine clearance estimated by Cockcroft-Gault, mL/min/1.73 m2. Carries the formula error seen in augmented renal clearance.

columns.name: egfr_ckdepi_est_ml_min_173
columns.description: eGFR by CKD-EPI, mL/min/1.73 m2, same error structure.

columns.name: crrt_flag
columns.description: Continuous renal replacement therapy during the horizon.

columns.name: crrt_effluent_flow_L_h
columns.description: Effluent flow, L/h (0 when no CRRT).

columns.name: tbsa_pct
columns.description: Burned body surface, percent (0 when no burn).

columns.name: mic_mg_L
columns.description: Measured MIC, mg/L, on the two-fold dilution ladder.

patients_truth.description: Hidden truth behind each patient: true renal function, the pharmacokinetic model that governs the patient, individual parameters and random effects.

columns.name: model_id
columns.description: True pharmacokinetic model of the patient (M1-M4 meropenem, P1-P4 piperacillin); see the model registry.

columns.name: true_crcl_urinary_ml_min_173
columns.description: True urinary creatinine clearance, mL/min/1.73 m2.

columns.name: arc_true
columns.description: Augmented renal clearance by the true clearance (threshold 130).

columns.name: arc_prevalence_stratum
columns.description: Prevalence stratum used for the patient (low, central, high).

columns.name: q_L_h
columns.description: Inter-compartmental clearance, L/h (0 for one-compartment models).

columns.name: vmax_mg_h
columns.description: Maximal saturable elimination rate, mg/h (0 when linear).

columns.name: fu_axis_end
columns.description: Which end of the published unbound-fraction range the patient was drawn from (reference or measured).

columns.name: eta_2
columns.description: Random effect on central volume (log scale).

columns.name: eta_3
columns.description: Random effect on the third parameter (log scale, 0 if unused).

regimens.description: Five regimens per patient. Each regimen is a list of constant-rate infusion segments over 72 h.

columns.name: regimen
columns.description: A label bolus, B extended infusion, C continuous infusion, D continuous with drug monitoring and Bayesian adjustment, E oracle with true parameters.

columns.name: n_segments
columns.description: Number of segments with non-zero rate.

columns.name: seg_rate_mg_h
columns.description: Infusion rate in each segment, mg/h.

columns.name: dose_day1_mg
columns.description: Drug delivered in the first 24 h, mg.

columns.name: dose_capped
columns.description: True when the daily ceiling cut the requested dose.

regimen_metrics.description: Pharmacodynamic and safety metrics of each regimen in the 48-72 h window, computed on a one-minute grid from the true concentrations.

columns.name: ft_gt_mic_pct
columns.description: Percent of the window with free concentration at or above the MIC.

columns.name: ft_gt_4mic_pct
columns.description: Percent of the window with free concentration at or above four times the MIC.

columns.name: cavg_free_over_mic
columns.description: Mean free concentration divided by the MIC.

columns.name: css_in_4_8_flag
columns.description: Mean free concentration between 4 and 8 times the MIC.

columns.name: cavg_total_mg_L
columns.description: Mean total concentration in the window, mg/L.

columns.name: cmin_total_mg_L
columns.description: Lowest total concentration in the window, mg/L.

columns.name: cmax_total_mg_L
columns.description: Highest total concentration in the window, mg/L.

columns.name: cmin_free_mg_L
columns.description: Lowest free concentration in the window, mg/L.

columns.name: neurotox_flag
columns.description: Lowest total concentration above the published neurotoxicity threshold.

columns.name: nephrotox_flag
columns.description: Lowest total concentration above the published nephrotoxicity threshold.

columns.name: steady_state_reached
columns.description: Mean concentration of 48-60 h and 60-72 h differ by less than 5 percent.

columns.name: mero_in_8_16_flag
columns.description: Meropenem only: mean total concentration between 8 and 16 mg/L.

columns.name: mero_above_24_flag
columns.description: Meropenem only: mean total concentration above 24 mg/L.

tdm_samples.description: Two blood samples per patient for regimen D, at 24 h and 48 h, with assay noise.

columns.name: conc_measured_mg_L
columns.description: Measured total concentration, mg/L, with proportional assay error and a lower limit of quantification.

tdm_predictions.description: Predictions of the clinician's model for the samples, using only observable information: before any sample and after the first sample.

tdm_adjustments.description: Dose changes made in regimen D and the clearance estimates behind them.

columns.name: rate_initial_mg_h
columns.description: Infusion rate before the first sample, mg/h.

columns.name: rate_after_sample_1_mg_h
columns.description: Rate set after the first sample, mg/h.

columns.name: rate_after_sample_2_mg_h
columns.description: Rate set after the second sample, mg/h.

columns.name: estimated_clearance_after_sample_2_L_h
columns.description: Clearance estimated from samples 1 and 2, L/h.

pk_profiles.description: True concentration curves of all five regimens, every 10 minutes from 0 to 72 h.

columns.name: conc_total_mg_L
columns.description: True total concentration in plasma, mg/L.

model_registry.description: The eight published population models that govern patients, with structure, covariate form, population and source.

pathogen_mic.description: MIC distributions by species and drug used to draw patient MICs, with the epidemiological cut-off.
